name: Grilled Queso Panela With Roasted Tomatillo and Poblano Salsa

ingredients.name: packed roughly chopped fresh cilantro leaves, tender stems
freshly minced garlic, from about 1 medium clove

instructions.primary_message: Husk, wash, and halve the tomatillos. Finely dice the yellow onion. Cut the queso panela into 1/2-inch thick planks.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 large tomatillos
1 small yellow onion
12 oz queso panela

instructions.primary_message: For the Salsa: Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position (about 6-inches from broiler unit), and preheat broiler on high setting. Meanwhile, roast poblanos over an open flame on a gas stove or grill until skins are completely charred, 8 to 10 minutes. Place in a bowl, cover with plastic wrap, and let stand until cooled, 5 to 10 minutes. Peel off charred skins; remove stems and seed poblanos.

Place tomatillos, cut sides down, on a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet. Transfer to preheated broiler and cook until tomatillo skins have charred and flesh has softened completely, about 8 minutes. Transfer tomatillos to the jar of a blender along with poblanos, cilantro, lime juice, garlic, and sugar. Puree until very smooth. Transfer salsa to a small bowl. Season with salt and cayenne pepper to taste and thin with water, if necessary. Set aside.
For the Queso Panela: Mix onion and chopped cilantro together in a small bowl; set aside.

Light one chimney full of charcoal. When all charcoal is lit and covered with gray ash, pour out and spread the coals evenly over entire surface of coal grate. Alternatively, set all the burners of a gas grill to high heat. Set cooking grate in place, cover grill, and allow to preheat for 5 minutes. Clean and oil the grilling grate. Grill cheese slices until browned on both sides, 1-2 minutes per side. Remove from grill.
Place tortillas on grill and cook until warm and pliable, about 30 seconds per side.
Spread a layer of salsa on the bottom of a shallow dish or plate. Nestle cheese in salsa. Spoon onion and cilantro mixture on top and serve immediately with warm tortillas.

description: This grilled queso panela recipe pairs mild, pan-grillable cheese with a bright roasted tomatillo and poblano salsa for a flavorful, easy summer appetizer.
notes:
Optional or for serving: Corn tortillas, for serving

Optional substitutions: poblano pepper → 1 large poblano pepper; yellow onion → white onion
author: Joshua Bousel
